purpose: Check whether the live KSP Flight aerodynamic wrench API can evaluate an original-STS Mach/AoA/sideslip/bank grid without advancing or changing the live vessel.

qualification.note: Counterfactual Flight.simulate_aerodynamic_wrench_at results are simulations, not measured aerodynamic-force cells, a shadow-gate pass, or flight qualification.

provenance.inputStateOrigin: Direct read-only snapshot of the already-loaded live STS at the time recorded below; this state is not the 72 km checkpoint.
provenance.utPolicy: Pass the measured current UT explicitly to every wrench call.
provenance.angularVelocityPolicy: Zero angular velocity for the grid to isolate static aerodynamic wrench; same-state parity check also uses measured angular velocity.
provenance.controlSurfacePolicy: No control-surface, action-group, RCS, SAS, throttle, or vessel-state setters are called. The API uses the currently loaded vessel parts and control-surface state.

gridDefinition.basis: One directly measured live position/UT/STS configuration; position and atmosphere are fixed while velocity and orientation are counterfactually varied.
gridDefinition.machVelocityConstruction: Mach times the live measured local speed of sound; body rotation velocity is added so the API receives inertial velocity in the non-rotating frame.
gridDefinition.angleConvention: Calibrated against live Flight.angle_of_attack, Flight.sideslip_angle, Flight.roll, and Vessel.direction at the captured state.
gridDefinition.angleOfAttack28Deg: Diagnostic boundary sample matching the configured cap; no live command or limit change.
